About

What we install, and for whom

  • Solar installation

    Design, supply and installation of on-grid rooftop systems, from the mounting structure to the net meter, sized to your actual consumption.

  • Residential solutions

    Right-sized systems for houses and apartments, with guidance on the PM Surya Ghar subsidy so you know what to expect before you commit.

  • Commercial solutions

    Rooftop solar for shops, offices, schools and factories. Systems are sized to daytime load so most of what you generate is used on site.

Subsidy and net metering, in plain words

PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana pays a central subsidy to homeowners who install rooftop solar. The amount depends only on system size, and it is paid to your bank account after your system is commissioned. It is for residential connections; shops and factories are not covered.

Net metering lets your home use the solar power it makes and send the surplus to the PSPCL grid. The units you export are credited against the units you draw. Settlement rules are set by the state regulator, and we explain how they apply to your connection during the survey.

Punjab's free units. Domestic consumers currently get a monthly allowance of free units under the state scheme, subject to its conditions. Solar mainly reduces the units above that allowance, so your real saving depends on how much you use. Tell us your bill and we will work it out honestly.

From your bill to a working system

  1. Tell us your bill

    Use the estimator or message us. We size the system to what you actually use.

  2. Site survey

    We check roof space, shade and load, then confirm the scope and the firm price.

  3. Paperwork

    Net-metering application with PSPCL, and subsidy registration for eligible homes.

  4. Installation

    Structure, panels, inverter and wiring go in, usually over a few days.

  5. Going live

    PSPCL inspects and fits the net meter. Your system starts generating and the subsidy claim follows.

Questions we hear most

How much roof space does solar need?

About 100 sq ft of shadow-free space per kW. A 3 kW home system needs roughly 300 sq ft. Enter your roof space in the calculator and it will tell you if the system you want will fit.

Will my solar system work during a power cut?

A standard on-grid system switches off when the grid goes down, for the safety of line workers. If you want power during outages you need a hybrid system with batteries, which costs more. Tick the battery backup box in the calculator and we will quote it after the survey.

Do businesses get a subsidy?

The PM Surya Ghar subsidy is for homes only. Businesses can usually claim depreciation on solar assets and save on daytime electricity, but tax treatment depends on your situation, so confirm it with your CA.

How long does it take?

Installing the system usually takes a few days. The PSPCL inspection and net-meter installation typically add another 30 to 45 days. The subsidy for eligible homes is paid after commissioning.

How accurate is the online estimate?

It is a good guide for budgeting. The firm price depends on your roof type, structure height, cable length and equipment choice, which we confirm at the site survey.

What about maintenance and warranty?

Panels need regular cleaning to keep output up, and the inverter should be checked periodically. Warranty on each product is as per the manufacturer's terms.

How this is calculated
  • Prices come from the Solar Everyday price list for the product type, capacity, subsidy status and system option you choose. The actual price includes GST (panels at 5%, inverter and battery at 18%) and is the price without subsidy.
  • For subsidy systems, the amount the customer has to pay is the figure shown in the price list after subsidy. For non-subsidy systems the customer pays the actual Standard or Eastman price.
  • Final value = customer price + extra charges − discount.
  • Savings assume each kW makes about 120 units a month, up to 90% of your usage if you enter your bill, with output falling 0.5% a year and no tariff increase.
  • Final scope and price are confirmed after a site survey.
